Create-only destination is a commit expected_version=absent requirement in packaging, not a property proven by merely opening the loader path. No upload or transport executed in this review.

Partial Runner remains available after constructor failure. Key evidence fields are initialized before owned-root creation. Before root/out creation the complete failure receipt is stdout; after creation the final source guard is attempted. A final guard failure forces code 1 and OPEN_FINAL_GUARD_FAILURE; capacity or receipt-save errors also force nonzero. Existing source/index/lock guard remains fail-closed.

source_guard invokes preflight_environment each time, so the newly pinned external build inputs are rechecked by path/bytes/SHA, not merely reported. GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 requirement preserves the previously accepted no-index-refresh plan.

The actual fixed target declares long. defs forwards it to workspace_root_test. Fixed .bazelrc and the complete original Core job log have no test_timeout override. The new runner requires natural elapsed duration <=900 seconds; it explicitly does not claim external Bazel timeout enforcement and does not kill the full Rust process at that bound. The original child/body 5-second budget is independent.

Pinned tracing APIs and poll ordering are consistent with the intended first-registration cache mechanism: a live Dispatch allows TRACE max-level, a separate worker with no default subscriber first polls the shared parent callsite without creating the child callsite, and a later WithSubscriber poll can observe the fresh child callsite. The shared mode must reach its partial-span marker then fail at the designated final chain assertion with exit101; earlier setup/assertion failures are not causal qualification. Isolated mode uses a fresh owned same-executable child. This is a separate controlled mechanism probe, not proof of the observed CI thread interleaving.
